title: VFDB/CUDB 校准保护扩训预注册 (v6 candidate)
purpose: Audit/plan for adding VFDB+CUDB as a new data source to the clean v3-A pipeline, with explicit calibration protection. The raw audit, deploy-causal preprocessing, and record-level split audit are done; training is NOT approved by this file.

data.note: VFDB 22 records + CUDB 35 records. After strict 250-point deploy-causal extraction and provisional rhythm labels: 29 records with usable beats, 67,249 beats (N=26,331, A=40,918, excluded=8,325 discarded from arrays). CUDB XQRS detection failed on 28/35 records; only 7 CUDB records contributed beats.

label_map.cudb: pre-'[' normal; '['->']' VF abnormal; post-']' excluded
label_map.note: provisional map already used for feasibility arrays; final decision locked here if training is approved

training_plan_if_approved.data_mix: v3-A train split (existing distill_pilot_teacher_targets.npz train x/y) + VFDB/CUDB train split only. VFDB/CUDB val/test are NEVER used for training or early-stopping.
training_plan_if_approved.optimizer: Adam + CosineDecay(3e-4, 80*steps), batch 32, epochs 80, patience 20, monitor val_auc, restore best
training_plan_if_approved.loss: hard-label CE, no distillation, no teacher targets

calibration.method: post-hoc isotonic or temperature scaling fitted on val/probabilities (monotone; ranking/AUC-invariant)
calibration.fit_data: val split only; never test; never VFDB test split
calibration.required_report: pre/post calibration Brier or ECE + theta=0.5 metrics

real_afe_holdout_not_worse.criterion: mean_prob <= max(0.10, baseline_mean + 0.02) AND frac_gt_0.5 <= baseline_frac_gt_0.5

theta05_false_alarm_not_worse.criterion: pooled val normal beat frac>0.5 increase <= +0.02 vs baseline; pure-normal record alert blocks <= baseline count (from p1/val per-record blocks), reported as relative indicator
theta05_false_alarm_not_worse.note: baseline values loaded at evaluation time from disk; never hard-coded without proof

no_strategy_only.rule: A verdict cannot be PASS if calibration/theta=0.5/frozen-recall reports are missing.

verdict_semantics.PASS: primary reduction gate + guardrail A/B/C + all calibration protection gates pass
verdict_semantics.PARTIAL: primary passes but at least one guardrail/calibration gate breaks
verdict_semantics.UNPROVEN: primary does not pass or data/split impossible; not called disproven

tests_holdout: the existing 40-beat real AFE holdout remains untouched in training; used only in gates
known_limitations: VFDB/CUDB are not healthy-population SVEB Holter data like SVDB; VFDB N segments come from patients with malignant arrhythmias, so 'normal' here is normal-sinus morphology in a pathological population.
CUDB XQRS failure on 28/35 records reduces usablity; current usable set is mostly VFDB.
label map is provisional and must be re-confirmed before any training.
val double-use remains (early stopping + gates); numbers are relative indicators.
